title: Text 1
subtitle: 美国机场安检拥堵与 PreCheck 之困

sentences.en: First two hours, now three hours — this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
sentences.zh: 先是两小时，现在变成了三小时——这是当局建议人们赶国内航班时应提前到达的时间，至少在安检队伍不断加长的美国一些大型机场是如此。

sentences.en: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
sentences.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序，以换取更高水平的安全。

sentences.en: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
sentences.zh: 埃及航空公司804号航班的坠毁——恐怖分子可能在地中海上空击落了该航班——再次以悲剧提醒人们个中原因。

sentences.en: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
sentences.zh: 但是，对航空旅客要求过多，或反之提供的安全保障过少，都会削弱公众对安检程序的支持。

sentences.en: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
sentences.zh: 而这种担心是应当的：浪费时间会拖累美国人的经济和私人生活，更不用说令人恼火了。

sentences.en: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons — both fake and real — past airport security nearly every time they tried.
sentences.zh: 去年，美国运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现，便衣调查人员几乎每次尝试都能把武器——无论是假的还是真的——带过机场安检。

sentences.en: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International.
sentences.zh: 此后加强的安检措施，加上经济改善和油价下跌所导致的航空出行人数增加，使芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等大型机场出现了长时间的排队。

sentences.en: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become — but the lines are obvious.
sentences.zh: 航空安全到底变得有多有效，目前尚不清楚——但排队的队伍是明摆着的。

sentences.en: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
sentences.zh: 部分问题在于，政府没有预见到航空出行人数的急剧增加，因此TSA现在正急于招募新的安检员上岗。

sentences.en: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.
sentences.zh: 部分问题在于，机场用于设立安检通道的空间只有那么多。

sentences.en: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
sentences.zh: 另一个因素可能是，越来越多的人试图把随身行李塞得过满，以规避托运行李费用，尽管航空公司对此坚决否认。

sentences.en: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
sentences.zh: TSA可以采取一个既无需改造机场、也无需仓促招人的步骤：让更多人加入PreCheck（预先安检）计划。

sentences.en: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.
sentences.zh: PreCheck本应是一项让旅客和TSA双赢的计划。

sentences.en: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
sentences.zh: 通过背景调查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

sentences.en: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 这样，TSA就能集中精力关注风险较高的旅客，从而为所有相关人员节省时间。

sentences.en: The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.
sentences.zh: TSA希望让2500万人加入PreCheck。

sentences.en: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
sentences.zh: 但距离这一目标还相差甚远，其中一个重要原因是“标价震惊”：旅客每五年须支付85美元来进行背景调查。

sentences.en: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，这一价格就是PreCheck计划的致命缺陷。

sentences.en: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.
sentences.zh: 即将进行的改革可能会把这一价格降到更合理的水平。

sentences.en: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
sentences.zh: 但国会应直接考虑采取这样的做法，比如为PreCheck的注册提供资金支持，或以其他方式降低成本。

sentences.en: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
sentences.zh: TSA不能继续把资源投到使用不足的PreCheck通道上，而让大多数出行公众在不必要的长队中受苦。

sentences.en: It is long past time to make the program work.
sentences.zh: 早就该让这个计划发挥作用了。

questions.stem: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804 is mentioned to ____

options.A: explain Americans’ tolerance of current security checks.
options.B: stress the urgency to strengthen security worldwide.
options.C: highlight the necessity of upgrading major U.S. airports.
options.D: emphasize the importance of privacy protection.

questions.analysis: 本题属于例证题，定位在第二段根据例证题的解题技巧。答案应该在例子的前面找，也就是本段的段首句：Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security protocols in return for increased safety. 美国人愿意忍受耗费时间的安全检查协议，为了换来更高的安全性。正好符合A选项解释了美国人能够忍受长时间的安全检查。

questions.stem: Which of the following contributes to long waits at major airports?

options.B: The declining efficiency of the TSA.
options.C: An increase in the number of travelers.

questions.analysis: 本题属于细节题，定位在第三段。Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports…, 安检措施的加强，航空旅游人员的增加，…导致了在主要机场的长时间等待。其他三项均不符合原文意思。

questions.stem: The word “expedited” (Para. 5) is closest in meaning to ____
questions.analysis: 本题属于猜词题，定位在第五段，expedited这个词所在的这句话，Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes. 通过背景核查的乘客有资格使用…拍摄通道；前文说Enroll more people in the PreCheck program，让更多的人注册预先检查程序，预先就是更快的，所以应该是faster。

questions.stem: One problem with the PreCheck program is ____

options.A: a dramatic reduction of its scale.
options.C: the government’s reluctance to back it.

questions.analysis: 本题属于细节题，定位在第六段。this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.价格问题是precheck的知名弱点，也就是题干中的问题，所以答案是an unreasonable price for enrollment，注册所需价格的不合理。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
questions.analysis: 本题属于主旨题，纵观全文，选择最佳答案。A. Less Screening for More Safety更少的检查，更多的安全. 与原文意思相反，原文说检查更多为了更多的安全；B. PreCheck – a Belated Solution. 预先检查-迟来的解决方案，文章是说道PreCheck，但它病没有从根本上解决旅客滞留的问题，所以也不对；D. 只是文章的一部分；只有C选项Getting Stuck in Security Lines，全文都是在围绕安检导致旅客滞留，解决方案PreCheck，但It is long past time to make the program work.并未根本解决问题。所以C更能概括全文。
